Field Descriptions

BIAS_EN

Layer-static. 1 = LOAD_WEIGHTS also fetches N per-column int32 biases from BIAS_ADDR. 0 = bias forced to 0.

ARRAY_EN

Master enable. 0 = all datapath clock gates forced off (state retained), commands other than ABORT/SOFT_RESET -> CMD_ERR.
